description: MUTATES one owned Food Diary row by food_id. Same fields as log_food; omitted stay. dish_items replaces the full dish list. A dish/notes correction never creates another Finance row. expense_id null unlinks. Unknown/other-user food_id or expense_id errors and changes nothing. Share tokens cannot write. ($0.10; API key required)

calories.description: Corrected kcal (0 is real). User-stated unless calories_source is agent_estimate. null or calories_source "unknown" without calories clears to unknown (not zero). Omitted stays, except a corrected what re-derives an automatic estimate

calories_source.description: user (default) or agent_estimate. unknown without calories clears the kcal value

contains_alcohol.description: Whether it contains alcohol (beer, wine, spirits, cocktails)

description.description: Alias for what (the dish, not notes).

dish_items.description: Complete replacement ordered dish list; [] clears it.

expense_id.description: Link ONE owned Finance transaction UUID so the meal has one ledger row. Empty or null unlinks; the transaction stays

food_id.description: UUID of a food diary row the authenticated user owns

meal_period.description: Spoken period when consumed_at is omitted, e.g. "late lunch"

merchant.description: Restaurant, stall, or shop. Empty or null clears

notes.description: Replaces notes. Empty or null clears

paid_by.description: Who paid: name/alias; "self"/"me" = user (Finance); "unknown" = not known. Empty or null clears. Not a payment method

payment_method.description: How it was paid (cash, card, PayLah…). Saved on the linked Finance transaction; never changes paid_by

person_name.description: One companion to add, by name

place.description: Venue or location. Empty or null clears

request_id.description: Client idempotency key (retries return original result).

what.description: Full updated dish/drink text (replaces, does not append). Example: Salmon Bento + hot tea

with.description: Companion names, aliases, or ids to add (does not remove existing tags)

provenance.description: Which connector wrote the record and which connected Dayze account received it.
